title: Targets and Warplanes Formation
description: Dense layered collage on USPS Priority Mail envelopes features multiple target rings, side-view warplane silhouettes, compact discs, a red chess pawn, and an American football scattered across the picture plane. Red tape, yellow ribbon, iridescent sequins, and a cartoon animal figure add further layering amid black-and-white concentric bullseyes.
composition: dense layered elements across full picture plane
